parameters.reason: Published Ensman-derived FLD and M1 shock definitions are documented, but no execution contract, equation-matched reference data, or supported full hydro run is verified. This case remains unimplemented; see doc/ensman-reference-followup.md.

common_reported_inputs.comparison_coordinate: s = x - u*t, where u is the signed negative initial inflow velocity
common_reported_inputs.initial_flux_contract: Requires verification in the source convention; equal gas/radiation temperatures alone do not specify lab-frame flux in moving matter
common_reported_inputs.opacity_evolution_contract: Record published kappa*rho separately from a chosen executable cm2/g or 1/cm prescription; do not infer its density dependence from its initial value

kolb2013.label: Ensman-derived PLUTO FLD reproduction, not an exact M1 reference
kolb2013.geometry: quasi-1D Cartesian; the paper labels its longitudinal coordinate z
kolb2013.limitations: Radiation advection and radiation-pressure work are omitted in the published equations; FLD has no separately evolved radiation flux

melon_fuksman2021.label: Ensman-derived PLUTO grey M1 reproduction, not an equation-identical reference for this implementation
melon_fuksman2021.flux_normalization: Paper F_r is physical flux divided by c; compare its F_r/E_r to physical F/(c*E)
melon_fuksman2021.limitations: Right boundary is not specified in section IV.1; grid count is internally inconsistent; equation (8) retains pressure-tensor and selected beta^2 terms not present in the current isotropic source model

reference_data.owner: Published reproduction definitions verified; numerical-reference contract pending
reference_data.description: Kolb et al. (2013) section 4.5 and Melon Fuksman et al. (2021) section IV.1 give verified published shock setups. Neither provides an exact reference for the present equations. No machine-readable curve or execution result is claimed.

tolerance_policy.description: Cannot pass without verified definition/reference; no invented tolerance
